selection_rationale: Target direct DNg100→MN bypass and E2→I1 transmission, then manually reduce unknown terminal efficacy or common MN excitatory gain without changing anatomical counts.

cut_E2_I1.scope: diagnostic cut, not a candidate model

cut_DN_MN.scope: diagnostic cut, not a candidate model

E2_silenced_cut_DN_MN.scope: diagnostic cut, not a candidate model

DN_MN_half.origin: manual unmeasured efficacy trial, preserves all real edges

DN_MN_quarter.origin: manual unmeasured efficacy trial, preserves all real edges

MN_gain3.origin: manual shared MN receptor-gain trial, original 6; no change to resting input resistance

MN_gain1p5.origin: manual shared MN receptor-gain trial, original 6; all pathways scaled consistently

cut_E2_E3_I1.scope: diagnostic combined direct and relay input cut
